title: iSmash Everett email refresh — 2026-10-14
source: Microsoft Outlook Email connector search_messages, list_messages and list_attachments
scope: Carney, Alex/NW Prime, Onesta LLC, iSmash, City of Everett, Quaint Oak, GPN Architecture, Bay Alarm, Motion Property Group, Mill Creek Plumbing, Thomas Sign and Insurance Allies; relevant owner correspondence.
limitations: Bounded refresh, not a complete mailbox, original MIME export, or forensic acquisition. Exhausted returned pagination for the 25 search queries (29 pages).

Message objects, including quoted chains and contentType labels, preserved as returned by the connector; body representation may be Markdown rather than original HTML. No full-message fetch was needed because search returned bodies.
E001-E081 are local snapshot reference labels, not Outlook IDs. Original Outlook IDs and links are in each message object.
Incoming and outgoing records are distinguished by sender. Owner reports, third-party assertions and plans are not treated as verified construction completion or City permit issuance.

Attachment metadata only: eight newly relevant messages inspected, with 10 non-inline attachment instances plus 14 inline instances. Payloads were not downloaded locally or substantively reviewed. One older October 6 invoice attachment is already indexed in the prior archive and was not re-listed.

Domain-only from:bayalarm.com returned no results, while exact from:dianna.williams@bayalarm.com located E004. This illustrates search-filter coverage limits; a zero domain search is not proof of no correspondence.
No new direct Troy or Onesta response was located in the searched period. No new Quaint Oak email was located. This is not a statement about communications outside this mailbox.
City receipt/intended routing of the tenant revision on October 9 is not City approval; Roger's October 12 portal observation is not proof of completed review.

The earlier October 6 owner-reported landlord permit approval is qualified by Alex's October 9 waiting-for-approval reply and the owner's subsequent report of missing contractor information. No issued stair permit or completed stair work was authenticated here.

Bay Alarm's October 12 'I can put' wording offers temporary cancellation for three months, with automatic reinstatement; no effective cancellation/reinstatement date or completed account change was independently verified. No City or insurer authorization to suspend monitoring was located.
Contains private correspondence, personal contact information and tokenized portal/meeting links. Keep local and redact before outside sharing.

approval on August 19, 2026, which was substantially longer than we expected
and required considerable follow-up and management on our side.
